answer: Formal differential expression analysis is complete. Under the approved primary analysis (19 samples; rowSums>=10 filter; design ~ sex + condition; Wald test; BH correction; contrast ASXL1 (disease) vs Control; apeglm-type LFC shrinkage), the total number of significantly differentially regulated genes at padj < 0.05 is **1,416 (855 up in ASXL1 vs Control, 561 down)**. Sensitivity analyses: design ~ condition only → 985 (685 up / 300 down); CPM>1 (>=2 samples) filter instead of rowSums>=10 → 1,441 (752 up / 689 down). The result is moderately robust to these choices (range 985–1,441); the sex-adjusted design with rowSums>=10 gives the primary answer of 1,416. Script/executable analysis: analysis/deseq2_asxl1.py.
